title: Sustainability disclosure — preparing for FINMA Circular 2024/2 deadline
content: FINMA Circular 2024/2 has a phased disclosure timeline; the next milestone is the institutional-client templates due 2026-09-30. CPI Compliance has prepared standardised summary packs that RMs can hand to foundation boards and pension trustees. Reminder: clients with explicit ESG mandates need both the portfolio-level ESG composite report and the exclusion-list compliance statement. RMs covering pension and foundation segments should plan a touch-base before 2026-Q3 reviews. See also reg-001 for the underlying interpretation memo.
